chunks: Then there will come seven years of hardship which will consume the grain you had laid up against them, except a little you may have stored away.
ai.seo_question: What are the seven years of hardship mentioned in Surah Yusuf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine wisdom behind Prophet Joseph's (AS) strategic economic planning, illustrating the principle of 'taqwa' (God-consciousness) through practical foresight. The 'seven years of hardship' are understood not merely as a natural disaster but as a test of faith and a mechanism for preserving the community's spiritual and material integrity during the lean years.
